ueransim.truth_label: abstract 5G RAN/UE protocol emulator; not an NR PHY and not OTA
ueransim.strength: fastest reproducible SA control/user-plane smoke test with a native per-session namespace
ueransim.boundary: does not validate waveform, coding, scheduler, K2, beamforming, or radio propagation

oai.truth_label: protocol/PHY implementation over RFsimulator; not OTA
oai.strength: deepest RRC/NAS/PDCP/RLC/MAC/PHY visibility among the three SA backends
oai.boundary: highest startup/resource cost and a software channel rather than measured RF

oransc_m.software: O-RAN SC M near-RT RIC platform + official ns-O-RAN scenario-zero
oransc_m.truth_label: protocol-level O-RAN SC platform interoperability; not OTA

compatibility_repairs.reason: the deployed RTMgr REST process listens on 3800 while the unmodified service targeted 8080
the release-M E2Term static RMR table omitted E2 Setup message type 12001 to E2Mgr

oransc_m.boundary: This is a compatibility-patched E2 Setup interoperability pass. It does not establish KPM subscription, RC control, user-plane gain, stability, or over-the-air behavior; those stages are tested separately with FlexRIC and srsRAN.
